results.content: ## [論文評述] Quantum-enhanced long short-term memory with attention for spatial permeability prediction in oilfield reservoirs. [# [論文評述] Quantum-enhanced long short-term memory with attention for spatial permeability prediction in oilfield reservoirs](/file? The paper introduces the Quantum-enhanced Long Short-Term Memory with Attention (QLSTMA) model, a novel hybrid quantum-classical neural network designed for spatial permeability prediction in oilfield reservoirs. QLSTMA integrates Variational Quantum Circuits (VQCs) into the recurrent cells of an LSTM network, leveraging quantum superposition and entanglement to enhance feature extraction and modeling capabilities, particularly for long-range spatial dependencies. 1. **QLSTM-SG (Shared Gate)**: All four LSTM gates (forget $f\_t$, input $i\_t$, candidate cell state $\tilde{c}*t$, and output $o\_t$) share a single VQC for quantum feature transformation. The combined input $W [x\_t \quad h*{t-1}]^T + b$ is processed by one VQC: $\begin{bmatrix} f\_t \ i\_t \ \tilde{c}*t \ o\_t \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \sigma \ \sigma \ \tanh \ \sigma \end{bmatrix} \left( \text{VQC} \left( W \begin{bmatrix} x\_t \ h*{t-1} \end{bmatrix} + b \right) \right)$ This design reduces computational cost but limits the granularity of quantum feature extraction.
